name: ssl-4k-e-glue
description: Gentle SSL-console GLUE for a drum/mix bus from the SSL 4K E alone — the clean British counterpart to API forwardness and tape warmth. '02 Brown' EQ (the original musical E EQ) for a small low shelf + de-box + air shelf, and the channel VCA comp at a low 2:1 ratio, slow attack (FAST out), modest GR for cohesion WITHOUT squashing transients. Measured on watercolors bus_punchy_pre (60 s dry drum bus): crest 21.6 -> 20.8 (gently denser), centroid mildly up (air shelf), corr 0.984. This is a glue pass, not a punch pass — for punch/weight use ssl-4k-e-drum-bus.json (Black EQ + 4:1).
intended_for: a near-final drum bus or mix bus that needs cohesion + a touch of E-EQ tone — NOT a master (no limiting). The [[finalize-mix]] stage done with a real console strip.
plugin_build: SSL 4K E.vst3 (VST3 — renders headless via Pedalboard; iLok/PACE, authorized on this machine; RE-VERIFY elsewhere with presets/vst/probe_plugin.py 'SSL 4K E')
headless_notes: String enums (compressor_ratio '2.0', eq_colour 'Brown', lf_type/hf_type, the Out/In routing toggles) MUST go through this harness's setattr — apply-vst-chain's float dict reports them set but the value silently does not take. high_pass_filter_hz is snapped to the nearest valid log-step by the harness. output is peak-trimmed.
notes: Low ratio (2:1) + slow attack + a few dB GR = glue, not control. Keep crest within ~1 dB of dry; if it drops more, raise the threshold.

Brown EQ = the airiest/brightest of the three colours for the same dial (so the +2 @ 12 k shelf reads as open, not harsh — constant-Q, no proportional narrowing). For a darker/weightier glue switch eq_colour to 'Black'.

Parallel-glue variant: set compressor_ratio '10.0', compressor_threshold_db -20, compressor_fast_attack 'In', compressor_mix 40 (the COMPRESS MIX knob = NY parallel on the channel) — measured tightest L/R corr (0.985) of the bus variants, denser but brighter.
